auth_version.description: OpenStack Identity API version (typically '2' or '3'). Use '3' for modern deployments.

region_name.description: OpenStack region containing the Nova compute resources to fence.

auth_url.description: Keystone identity endpoint URL. Must include the path and version.

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the service account used to perform fencing.

project_id.description: Optional project (tenant) ID. Use if you want to avoid name lookup (e.g., for multi-region or name collisions).

username.description: Service account username with Nova 'admin' role on target project.

password.description: Password for the service account. Should be stored securely (e.g., via vault or file permissions).

domain_name.description: Domain name for user/project (required for Keystone v3+). Leave empty if using v2.0.

trust_id.description: Optional trust ID for delegation (used in advanced trust-scoped scenarios).

insecure.description: Skip SSL certificate verification. Only enable in lab/test environments.

ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle file for TLS verification. Omit if using system CA store.

nova_endpoint.description: Override Nova service endpoint (e.g., 'https://nova.region.example.com:8774/v2.1'). Defaults to catalog lookup.

retry_timeout.description: Total timeout (in seconds) for a fencing operation (sum of retries).

retry_count.description: Maximum number of retry attempts per fencing action.

retry_max_delay.description: Maximum delay (in seconds) between retries. Delay increases exponentially up to this value.

servers.description: List of Nova server (VM) UUIDs to fence. Typically populated automatically by the cluster manager when fencing is invoked. Provided here only for documentation.
